defect: The file is 12,254 bytes. That is under 12 KiB (12,288) but over 12 KB (12,000); the spec's unit is ambiguous, so the file may fail a byte-count gate by 254 bytes.
fix: Shorten the header comment (lines 1-8) — e.g. delete lines 5-7 ('Tokens come from…', 'Cascade: …', 'in <body> AFTER…') — so the file is below 12,000 bytes; no CSS change needed.

rule: valid HTML in the contact line (SPEC §5.4)
defect: `href="{{ ens_href }}"` prints the mailto with a raw `&` between `subject=` and `body=` (`…&body=…`). Browsers recover, but it is not a valid attribute value and validators/verify.js HTML parsers may flag it; the hero has the same habit, which is not a licence.
fix: Change the attribute to `href="{{ ens_href | replace: '&', '&' }}"` (the value is already URL-encoded, so no other `&` exists).

rule: SPEC §6.2 'collection.image' / P3 store images in store order
defect: `assign img = col.image | default: col.featured_image` — `collection.featured_image` falls back to the first product's image, so a collection that loses its own image would silently show a product photo cropped 4/5 as the collection tile. The spec names `collection.image` only. No visible effect today (all four collections have images), but the fallback hides a content gap the owner should see.
fix: Replace line 17 with `assign img = col.image` (the `{%- if img != blank -%}` guard on line 25 already handles the empty case).

rule: valid HTML — unique ids per section instance
defect: The section root, its heading and `aria-labelledby` use fixed ids (`ens-collections`, `ens-coll-h2`); `sections/elmsnest-s-fit.liquid` line 8/11 does the same (`ens-fit`, `ens-fit-h2`). Adding either section twice in the editor yields duplicate ids and broken aria-labelledby. `sections/elmsnest-s-terms.liquid` already suffixes with `section.id`.
fix: Use `id="ens-coll-h2-{{ section.id }}"` / `aria-labelledby="ens-coll-h2-{{ section.id }}"` (and `ens-fit-h2-{{ section.id }}` in elmsnest-s-fit.liquid lines 8 and 11); drop the fixed `id="ens-collections"` / `id="ens-fit"` on the roots or suffix them likewise.

rule: no WhatsApp in any form (SPEC §1 #3, hard rule) — OUT OF SCOPE for the home group, flagged for the lead
defect: The dev-theme hero (on the home template) still carries the schema label «כפתור משני — טקסט (וואטסאפ)» — the word וואטסאפ in editor-only text. It never reaches the storefront (index.json sets cta_secondary_label to ""), but the rule bans the word in any form and the critique noted it.
fix: In sections/elmsnest-v2-hero.liquid line 245 change the label to «כפתור משני — טקסט» (spec §6.1 allows only the one-setting edit, so this is a lead decision: either accept the editor-only word or take this one-word label edit).
